summary.tldr: Requires a process to verify mobile coverage data and orders a review, update, and ongoing five-year reporting on Canada’s Spectrum Policy Framework.
what_it_does: Requires the Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission to set up, within six months, a process to check the accuracy of mobile network coverage data from Canadian carriers, including areas served and deployment requirements.
Requires the Minister of Industry to carry out a full review of the Spectrum Policy Framework for Canada within 18 months and table a report in both Houses of Parliament.

Requires the minister to consult telecom providers, spectrum licence holders, rural and remote municipalities, Indigenous communities, public safety agencies, researchers, the CRTC, and other chosen stakeholders.
Requires the review report to address consultation results, rural and remote connectivity, numbered roads, public safety, coverage data, and any changes the minister thinks are needed.
Requires the minister, every five years after the first report is tabled, to report on the Framework’s implementation and effectiveness and to publish each report online within 30 days.
summary.background: The bill deals with the Spectrum Policy Framework for Canada and creates new review and reporting duties linked to mobile network coverage data.
